title: Improving photocatalytic activity and chlorine resistance of carbon nanolayer-wrapped TiO2 nanocomposite catalysts for dichloromethane purification
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,2486-2494
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00109A, Paper
Hongli Liu, Jinhua Feng, Xin Wang, Maosen Xu, Yunzheng Deng, Guiying Li, Yingxin Yu, Taicheng An
Carbon nanolayer-wrapped TiO2 photocatalyst was engineered, in which preferential adsorption of dissociated chlorine on carbon layers and highly reactive radicals cooperatively improved dichloromethane degradation activity and chlorine resistance.
